method: max lag-1 spatial autocorrelation over 32x32 blocks (horiz+vert avg) of GT image. A genuinely corrupted (pure-noise) GT patch has NO block anywhere with real structure (max block correlation stays near 0); a real image -- even one with a noisy/grainy background and only sparse real content -- has at least some block with real structure (high correlation). This is more discriminating than whole-image average correlation, which false-flags real sparse-content-on-noisy-background images.
